calibration.note: Fitted out of sample: every rating used to predict season t was built only from seasons t-3 through t-1.

variance_split.note: sigma_team is a season-long, team-constant strength error. Without it the simulator understates win-total spread by roughly a third.

scoring_rules.win_totals: Brier score on P(over the posted line). Resolved by final record.
scoring_rules.playoffs: Brier score on P(makes the playoffs), 14 of 32 resolve true.
scoring_rules.division: Brier score on P(wins the division), 8 of 32 resolve true.
scoring_rules.super_bowl: Brier score on P(wins Super Bowl LXI), 1 of 32 resolves true.
scoring_rules.games: Straight-up accuracy against the closing line, mean absolute spread error, and total over/under record.
scoring_rules.benchmark: Every entry stores the de-vigged market number alongside the model number, so the season-end comparison needs no extra data.

streaming.method: Each week the streamer takes the unrostered starter facing the softest pass defense, rated only on games already played. Compared against the season-long QB at replacement rank.
